define(bytes, 8B 44 90 08 C3)

alloc(myPlayer, 4)

label(return)

registersymbol(myPlayer)

  mov [myPlayer],eax

desc: ⌨ Ctrl+F2: Max Stack ALL inventory items (hotkey)
script:
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
local function doMaxStack()
  local p = readInteger("myPlayer")
  if not p or p == 0 then return end
  local inv = readInteger(p + 0xD8)
  if not inv or inv == 0 then return end
  for slot=0,49 do
    local item = readInteger(inv + 8 + slot*4)
    if item and item ~= 0 then
      local itype = readInteger(item + 0x50)
      local maxS = readInteger(item + 0x68)
      if itype and itype > 0 and maxS and maxS > 1 then
        writeInteger(item + 0x64, maxS)
      end
    end
  end
end
maxStackHK = createHotkey(doMaxStack, VK_F2, VK_CONTROL)
{$asm}
